articles.title: Lido begins moving $16.5 billion in staked ether to cut validator count by a third
articles.snippet: The liquid staking protocol is consolidating 8 million ETH and requiring its professional node operators to post bonds for the first time.

articles.title: Nvidia forms 37-member AI security alliance without OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
articles.snippet: The chipmaker and 36 other companies say defenders need AI they can run themselves. Major AI players OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not among them.

articles.title: Bitcoin options traders are dropping their hedges going into the Fed meeting
articles.snippet: The put/call ratio has fallen to about 0.52 from 0.76 in late June, and one-week downside protection has collapsed in price. The options market is positioned for a quiet week that contains an FOMC decision.

articles.title: Cloud data firm Storj files for Chapter 11, extending a week of crypto failures. Token slides 16%
articles.snippet: The decentralized data storage company says operations continue and proposes that token holders take equity in the restructured business — an unusual arrangement in bankruptcy.

articles.title: Bitcoin is back above $65,000 as U.S. and Iran hold fire. Oil drops 5%
articles.snippet: ETH outperforms BTC, hinting at potential altcoin rally, as the U.S. and Iran hold fire and oil drops.
